exposure: addition of RAL to current ART
standard ART + RAL as fourth drug
finding: Raltegravir use in HIV-infected pregnant women was not associated with adverse events or vertical transmission, and was associated with viral load decrease.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was performed in 51.7% of the women.
gest_age: Median gestational age at RAL initiation was 34 weeks
